_comment: Shared AskCI events. Only status=confirmed events draw on charts. Personal markers added in the dashboard popover stay in the browser and are never written here. Fields: start (YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM), end (optional), kind (model | launch | chips | observed change | other), status (confirmed | candidate | rejected), evidence, applies_to, title, detail.

events.evidence: QA feed: Error outcome (empty response, 0 ms)
events.title: Error spike: 77% of turns failed
events.detail: 130 errors in 168 turns. Possible outage; confirm with the service team.

events.title: Model change: gpt-4o retired, GPT 5 Mini and GPT 5 added
events.detail: gpt-4o 1120 and gpt-4o-mini 0718 last billed 9 Mar; GPT 5 Mini first billed 9 Mar; GPT 5 first billed 10 Mar.

events.title: Pre-launch Modal rows: limited rollout or internal use
events.detail: 980 Modal turns in 464 conversations on 22 days from 5 Jan to 7 May, concentrated 24 Mar to 7 Apr (up to 130 a day). Confirm with OGCIO whether this was a limited rollout or internal testing. Kept in totals; the admin-app spec excludes them from Web-versus-Modal comparisons.

events.title: Search S1 daily cost steps from about £6 to about £11
Modal launch
events.detail: Public launch: from 11 May Modal carries 408 of 568 turns (72%) and about three quarters of turns since. Before that the feed holds 980 Modal turns in 464 conversations on 22 days between 5 Jan and 7 May, mostly 24 Mar to 7 Apr, which the admin-app spec treats as a limited rollout or internal use (to confirm). The spec's 1 May assumption for the public launch is not supported by the feed.

events.title: Error spike after the pop-up launch
events.detail: 54 errors in 496 turns on 13 May (11%), 68 in 548 on 14 May (12%). Confirm with the service team.

events.title: Label change
events.detail: Meaning still to confirm. The feed shows suggested follow-ups (chips) present since 1 Jan, so this is not their introduction; see the confirmed observed change on the same day.

events.title: Modal turns step from about 440 to about 820 a day
events.detail: Modal turns: 434 on 18 May, 442 on 19 May, 818 on 20 May, 959 on 21 May; Web turns unchanged at 130–180. Coincides with the candidate 'Label change' whose meaning is unconfirmed.

events.title: Error spike: 11% of turns failed
events.detail: 79 errors in 710 turns. Confirm with the service team.

events.title: Model change: GPT 5 Chat retired, chat-latest 05052026 added
events.detail: GPT 5 Chat last billed 30 Jun; chat-latest 05052026 first billed 1 Jul. Generation cost per turn 0.49p in June to 2.94p in July. Before/after, complete months, sum then divide (cost brief 5.7): cited answer rate 86.2% → 91.8% of scored turns; cited but partial 3.0% → 14.0%; not found 8.2% → 3.5%; clarification 4.3% → 4.5%; response time p50 11.3s → 12.5s, p90 16.3s → 17.0s; dislikes per 1,000 cited answers 1.73 → 1.19 (32 and 19); likes per 1,000 4.16 → 3.77. Aug 1–17 separately: cited 91.6%, partial 13.9%, p50 11.9s, dislikes per 1,000 1.66. Descriptive only; the deployment change is not isolated from other changes in the window.

events.title: Chip set change: three starter prompts added
events.detail: Back to School Clothing and Footwear Allowance, HAP limits and passport renewal first appear as first turns on 15–16 Jul (passport was asked a few times before). Inferred from the feed; confirm with the AskCI team.

events.title: Chip set change: three starter prompts removed
events.detail: Low pay, maternity benefit and auto-enrolment chips last asked on 10 Sep, three days before the 14 Sep model change. Inferred from the feed; confirm with the AskCI team.

events.title: Model change: GPT 5, GPT 5 Mini and chat-latest retired, 5.4 and 5.4 mini added; voice meters begin
events.detail: GPT 5, GPT 5 Mini and chat-latest 05052026 last billed 14 Sep; 5.4 and 5.4 mini first billed 14 Sep. gpt-4o-transcribe (speech-to-text) and Neural Text To Speech under Foundry Tools also first billed 14 Sep.

events.title: Outcome shift with the 14 Sep model change
events.detail: 26 Aug-13 Sep vs 14 Sep-22 Oct: cited answer 92.7% -> 82.2% of scored turns, not found 2.7% -> 8.2%, clarification 4.6% -> 9.4%, partial 13.9% -> 26.2% of cited; errors unchanged. Not yet known whether answers changed or the text rules misread the new model's wording; a hand-labelled sample will settle it.

events.title: Error spike: 5% of turns failed
events.detail: 47 errors in 905 turns. Confirm with the service team.

events.evidence: GA4: citizensinformation.ie had 105,946 sessions (about 3.5 times a typical Tuesday) and heavy views of the Budget 2027 page; AskCI QA feed
events.title: Budget Day (Budget 2027)
events.detail: AskCI's busiest day: 2,213 questions in 1,314 conversations, 2.4 times the previous four Tuesdays' average of 924. Money and tax citations about 8 times a typical Tuesday; 394 questions after 8pm. Error rate 1.3%, normal.

events.title: Chip change: Household Benefits Package replaces Back to School
events.detail: Back to School chip last asked 13 Oct; 'How do I apply for the Household Benefits Package' asked as a first turn 32 times on 14 Oct and about 120 a week since. Inferred from the feed; confirm with the AskCI team.
